description: The 0.5.0 retrospective (2026-11-05) found that a blocking full-matrix release UAT was added by coverage, never calibrated on hosted runners, and that process machinery (oracle, release workflow) shipped without live execution. The owner decided on 2026-11-05: (1) continuous UAT on trunk, nightly at 02:00 UTC and skipped when nothing relevant changed; a release checks evidence instead of running UAT, with full UAT only as a fallback. This supersedes the 2026-10-28 decision 'no reduction of UAT or gate coverage' and the 'artifact-bound release UAT' requirement in docs/internal/release-artifacts.md. (2) A standing release-window freeze: no infrastructure, oracle or CI-machinery merges between an rc tag and its PyPI publish. (3) New guardrail G12, calibrate before block: a new blocking gate needs a hosted calibration run, a measured runtime, a runner budget and a statement of what it catches. (4) The agent gate-tuning rubric (image digest pins; one recorded automatic retry for infrastructure signatures; envelope moves only above 20% infrastructure-failure rate over the last 10 runs, with another scale of the same platform x benchmark still gated, evidence cited and a tracker item filed; never a timeout, memory-limit or validation change). (5) Theseus/oracle is consumed as a pinned dependency: bumps go through a canary procedure and a fail-closed posting check, rollback is reverting the pin, and nothing changes during a release window. (6) Release-v2 probe mode and fail-closed detectors are required. (7) Envelope-only fixes need no special evidence path; continuous trunk UAT supersedes the wheel-digest binding idea. Fixed names for the other items: trunk UAT workflow `.github/workflows/trunk-uat.yml`; freeze check: the existing required `hold` context in pr-hold.yml. Scope: edit only the UAT/gate sections (release-guide.md 'Release UAT in release-v2', release-artifacts.md 'Release requirements') and the ADR; rv2r-03 owns the candidate-rule text; dlv2-53 owns legacy-path sections. Docs only. Rollback: revert the doc commit.
